basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Project Research Scientist, Project Nurse and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Radiation Oncology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi is accepting applications for 4 contractual posts under the ICMR-funded project titled “Phase III Randomized Trial Comparing Extended Field Bone Marrow Sparing IG-IMRT with Concurrent Chemotherapy Versus Neoadjuvant Plus Concurrent Chemotherapy in Carcinoma Cervix with Para-Aortic Lymphadenopathy” (Project Code- I-2044). important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates

how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can submit their applications either by email or by hand, using the following steps:
Prepare an updated CV clearly mentioning the percentage score or CGPA obtained in the qualifying examination.
Attach a recent passport-size photograph to the application or CV.
Enclose or attach copies of supporting documents, restricted strictly to the qualifying degree and marksheets only.
If applying by email, send the complete application and attachments to [email protected] before the closing deadline.

If applying in person, place the documents inside a sealed envelope superscribed with the name of the post and deliver it to Room No. 301, Main Radiotherapy, Department of Radiation Oncology, AIIMS, New Delhi.
Ensure the submission reaches the designated email address or room on or before 13 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Appointments are purely contractual and co-terminus with the project; selected candidates have no claim for regular employment at AIIMS, New Delhi or ICMR. The cutoff date for determining the upper age limit is the last date of application submission (13 November 2026). Experience will only be counted after acquiring the prescribed minimum essential qualification, and only relevant experience will be accepted. The competent authority reserves the right to revise or cancel the recruitment process or alter the number of posts without assigning any reason. For queries related to the recruitment notice, candidates may contact the department at 011-2659-4414.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies have been notified across four distinct project positions on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications and experience criteria for all positions follow the official ICMR guidelines. The cutoff date for determining the upper age limit is 13 November 2026. All educational qualifications must be obtained from a recognized university, board, or institution. Where experience is prescribed, it will only be counted after the completion of the minimum essential qualification, and only experience in the relevant field or area required for the project will be considered. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India and ICMR rules, wherever admissible. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected personnel will receive fixed monthly emoluments along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible according to project funding rules: Project Research Scientist-I (Medical): Rs. 67,000/- per month + HRA as admissible. Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): Rs. 56,000/- per month + HRA as admissible. Project Nurse-I: Rs. 18,000/- per month + HRA as admissible. Project Technical Support-I: Rs. 18,000/- per month + HRA as admissible. All appointments are purely temporary and contractual in nature and will run co-terminus with the ICMR research project. The appointment confers no right or claim for regular absorption or permanent appointment at AIIMS, New Delhi or ICMR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates can submit their applications either by email or by hand, using the following steps: Prepare an updated CV clearly mentioning the percentage score or CGPA obtained in the qualifying examination. Attach a recent passport-size photograph to the application or CV. Enclose or attach copies of supporting documents, restricted strictly to the qualifying degree and marksheets only. If applying by email, send the complete application and attachments to [email protected] before the closing deadline. If applying in person, place the documents inside a sealed envelope superscribed with the name of the post and deliver it to Room No. 301, Main Radiotherapy, Department of Radiation Oncology, AIIMS, New Delhi. Ensure the submission reaches the designated email address or room on or before 13 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and submitted applications. The selection process involves the following stages: Shortlisting: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to attend the interview. Interview: The date, time, and venue or mode of interview will be communicated directly to shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Document Verification: Candidates appearing for an in-person interview must bring their original certificates and documents for verification. Selected candidates will be required to submit self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies in total, with 1 post each for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Project Nurse-I, and Project Technical Support-I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS project vacancies?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 13 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for Project Research Scientist-I (both Medical and Non-Medical), 28 years for Project Nurse-I, and 25 years for Project Technical Support-I as on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by emailing their CV and supporting documents to [email protected] or submitting them in a sealed envelope at Room No. 301, Main Radiotherapy, Department of Radiation Oncology, AIIMS, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. Are these permanent jobs at AIIMS New Delhi?
faq.answer: No, all posts are purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the ICMR research project, and carry no claim for regular appointment at AIIMS or ICMR.

faq.question: Q6. Will House Rent Allowance (HRA) be provided with the monthly salary?
faq.answer: Yes, all posts carry fixed monthly emoluments plus HRA as admissible under project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, candidates called for the interview will not be paid any TA/DA.
